---
title: "Choropleth map"
description: "An sf object drawn directly with mark_sf() and a proper map projection via coord_sf()."
categories: [Spatial]
---

```{r}
#| include: false
source("_helper.R")
```

vellumplot reads simple-features geometry directly. `mark_sf()` draws the
polygons and `coord_sf()` handles the projection and aspect ratio.

```{r}
nc <- sf::st_read(system.file("shape/nc.shp", package = "sf"), quiet = TRUE)

p <- vplot(nc, width = 8, height = 3.6) |>
  mark_sf(fill = BIR74) |>
  coord_sf() |>
  labs(title = "Births by county, North Carolina (1974)", fill = "births")
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
vg(p, "choropleth")
```
